commit e1702f4449e63317533c48bf0265da0012eaf463
Author: Tommy Leonhardsen <tommy.leonhardsen@gmail.com>
Date:   Thu Aug 13 08:54:49 2026 +0200

    Steps 0-3: stream_tokens seam, backend detection, OptimumSlot class
    
    - stream_tokens(raw_messages, gen, heartbeat, tag) is the new backend/
      protocol seam: owns worker thread, lock, _cancel.clear-inside-lock,
      _stream_error; consumers (stream_llm SSE, both Ollama ndjson emitters)
      own framing, TTFT, heartbeat policy, and the disconnect safety net.
      Fixes the ndjson paths reaching into slot.pipe directly.
    - NEEDS_OPTIMUM detection (muse_glimmer, nemotron_h) + Backend line in
      --scan + backend field in /health; supports_prefix_cache gates the
      prewarm prefill and the KV-pool preflight arm off for optimum slots.
    - OptimumSlot(DeviceSlot): optimum-intel python runtime, text-only
      (model_type llm even for VLM-shaped exports), TextIteratorStreamer
      over the same seam, GLOBAL_WORKERS=1 shard-load workaround, lazy
      imports so plain installs never pay the torch tax.
    - _idle_watchdog: skip slots without last_used (WhisperSlot crash).
    
    GenAI regression on SmolLM3/CPU: stream+non-stream OpenAI, both Ollama
    ndjson paths, cancel mid-stream (finish_reason cancelled, clean next
    request), /health — all green, frames byte-identical.
    
    Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

 nollama.py | 425 +++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++----------------
 1 file changed, 317 insertions(+), 108 deletions(-)

    - NEEDS_OPTIMUM detection (muse_glimmer, nemotron_h) + Backend line in
+NEEDS_OPTIMUM = {"muse_glimmer", "nemotron_h"}
+def needs_optimum(model_dir):
+            return json.load(f).get("model_type", "").lower() in NEEDS_OPTIMUM
+    if needs_optimum(model_dir):
+        "backend": "optimum-intel (python runtime)" if needs_optimum(model_dir)
+    openvino_genai pipeline — for the NEEDS_OPTIMUM architectures GenAI can't
